chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza and Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When the woman menstruates while she is performing Tawaf by the House or between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, if she has passed the half, she should mark that place. So when she becomes pure, she returns and completes the remainder of her Tawaf from the place which she marked. If she cut off her Tawaf in less than the half, then upon her is that she resumes the Tawaf from its beginning.

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَ الْمَرْوَة: As-Safa and Al-Marwa (the two hills between which pilgrims walk during Sa'i)
key_terms.النِّصْف: The half (referring to half of the required circuits)

ai.seo_question: What should a woman do with her Tawaf if she starts menstruating during Hajj?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'half-completion' in Hajj rituals, reflecting the juristic consensus that validity is preserved once the majority of the circuit is performed. It highlights the practical flexibility in Shia fiqh, allowing the pilgrim to resume from the marked spot rather than restarting, thereby minimizing hardship during the sacred rites.
